title: adaptor.json
body:
{
  "id": "inkscape",
  "version": "schemaxis.inkscape/1",
  "adaptor": "schemaxis.adaptors.inkscape.adaptor",
  "runtimeFamily": "1.4.x",
  "executables": [
    "inkscape"
  ],
  "execution": "Intent-driven dependency diagrams and explicit technical diagrams with measured layout, editable SVG and native PNG export",
  "keywords": [
    "SVG",
    "diagram",
    "technical figure",
    "vector",
    "layout",
    "PNG",
    "DAG",
    "dependency",
    "flow diagram",
    "automatic layout"
  ],
  "capabilities": "schemaxis.adaptors.inkscape.capabilities:catalogue",
  "executionCapabilities": {
    "modes": [
      "process"
    ],
    "mpi": false
  },
  "consoleTemplate": {
    "version": "schemaxis.inkscape/1",
    "operation": "blockDiagram",
    "width": 120,
    "height": 60,
    "boxes": [
      {
        "id": "input",
        "label": "Input",
        "x": 10,
        "y": 15,
        "width": 30,
        "height": 20,
        "colour": "blue"
      },
      {
        "id": "result",
        "label": "Result",
        "x": 75,
        "y": 15,
        "width": 30,
        "height": 20,
        "colour": "green"
      }
    ],
    "links": [
      {
        "id": "flow",
        "source": "input",
        "target": "result"
      }
    ]
  },
  "consoleCapabilities": {
    "authoredSessions": true,
    "multipleDocuments": true,
    "liveGeometry": false,
    "nativeEditReverseSync": false
  },
  "routes": {
    "schemaxis.inkscape/1": {
      "module": "schemaxis.adaptors.inkscape.adaptor",
      "schema": "schemaxis.adaptors.inkscape.adaptor:schema",
      "graphEditing": false,
      "workflow": true,
      "scheduled": true,
      "compose": true,
      "schemaName": "inkscape",
      "acceptedArtifacts": [],
      "hooks": {
        "query": "schemaxis.adaptors.inkscape.adaptor:query",
        "reusableInputs": "schemaxis.adaptors.inkscape.adaptor:reusableInputs",
        "resources": "schemaxis.adaptors.inkscape.adaptor:resources"
      }
    }
  }
}
